name: ConflictCheckIntakeDesk
tagline: New-matter intake and conflicts clearance in one drop-in Power Apps component.
description: Partners submit new matters and engagements with their parties; the Risk & Intake team runs a fuzzy conflicts search against clients, adverse parties, corporate families and a PEP / sanctions list, decides every hit, and routes the intake for approval by risk score – ending with an engagement-letter trigger. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Fuzzy conflicts search (legal suffixes ignored) with an indexed register for 500+ matters
Direct conflict, former client, corporate family, name match, PEP and sanctions hits
Hit decisions: clear, waiver required / EDD, confirmed conflict
Approval routing by risk tier and waiver tracking
Allowed status transitions, confirmations, undo and activity log
Instant pre-check while typing a new intake
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: ConflictCheckIntakeDesk data-set + ConflictCheckIntakeDeskPortal field control)
